newsitem.title: USA: Firm to ask Portsmouth to hire adviser.
newsitem.headline: Firm to ask Portsmouth to hire adviser.

text.p: Ram Trust Services Inc said Wednesday it plans to submit a resolution at Portsmouth Bank Shares Inc's 1997 meeting urging the company to hire an investment bank to explore ways to raise shareholder value.

The Portland, Maine,-based firm said the investment bank should look at "all alternatives, including a possible sale, merger or other transaction for all assets of the company in conjunction with the possible return of excess capital to shareholders."

Ram, which holds a 6.68 percent stake in the bankholding company, said it also intends to propose two of its principals as candidates for inclusion in Portsmouth's slate of directors at the 1997 meeting, which is scheduled in April.
It identified its nominees as Ram president John Higgins and director Robert Monks.
